name: The Kanshikikan
source: In the near future, Japanese justice has been reformed and investigations are managed by both the government and private police forces. Step into the shoes of newbie inspector Enami Shikiko, who will have to solve cases with the help of her partners.
translation: 不久的将来，日本的司法制度完成改革，调查工作由政府与私人警察力量共同负责。请扮演新人督察江波志纪子，在搭档协助下解决案件。
